files_summary.world.json: Marketing domain: slack (3 channels + 75 messages), mailchimp (4 audiences + 14 campaigns with realistic open/click metrics), google_sheets (budget + audience roster worksheets).
files_summary.README.md: Schema, lifecycles and business rules of this benchmark's datastore.

tool_schemas.name: mailchimp_list_audiences
tool_schemas.description: Lists the Mailchimp audiences available to the connected account and returns each audience with its current member count. It refuses requests when Mailchimp is not connected or the account has no permission to list audiences. It may also refuse if the upstream Mailchimp service is unavailable or returns an authorization failure.

tool_schemas.name: mailchimp_list_campaigns
tool_schemas.description: Lists Mailchimp campaigns visible to the connected account and returns basic campaign details, optionally filtered by status. It refuses requests when the status filter is not one of the supported values (draft, sent, scheduled) or is otherwise invalid. It also refuses when Mailchimp is not connected or the account is not permitted to read campaigns.

tool_schemas.name: mailchimp_get_campaign_report
tool_schemas.description: Fetches and returns delivery and engagement metrics for a specific Mailchimp campaign, including sent/opens/clicks and their rates. It refuses requests that omit campaign_id or provide an empty/unknown campaign_id. It also refuses when the connected account cannot access that campaign or Mailchimp is not connected.

tool_schemas.name: mailchimp_create_campaign
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new draft Mailchimp campaign with the given title for the specified audience and returns the created campaign details. It refuses requests missing title or audience_id, with empty values, or where the referenced audience_id does not exist or is not accessible to the connected account. It also refuses when Mailchimp is not connected or the account lacks permission to create campaigns.

tool_schemas.name: google_sheets_list_spreadsheets
tool_schemas.description: Lists the Google Sheets spreadsheets available to the connected Google account and returns their basic identifiers and names. It refuses requests when Google Sheets is not connected or the account does not have permission to list files. It may also refuse when the upstream Google service denies access or is unavailable.

tool_schemas.name: google_sheets_get_values
tool_schemas.description: Returns all rows from the first worksheet of the specified spreadsheet and returns them as a list of rows (each row is a list of cell values). It refuses requests missing spreadsheet, with an empty identifier, or when no spreadsheet matching the provided name or id can be found. It also refuses when the spreadsheet is not accessible to the connected account or Google Sheets is not connected.

tool_schemas.name: google_sheets_append_row
tool_schemas.description: Appends a single row to the first worksheet of the specified spreadsheet and returns the updated append result. It refuses requests missing spreadsheet or row, where row is not an array of strings, or where the spreadsheet name/id cannot be resolved. It also refuses when the spreadsheet is read-only or not accessible to the connected account, or when Google Sheets is not connected.

row.description: Cell values for the new row.

tool_schemas.name: slack_list_channels
tool_schemas.description: Lists channels in the connected Slack workspace and returns their basic details (such as id and name). It refuses requests when Slack is not connected or the token cannot list channels in the workspace. It may also refuse when the workspace restricts channel visibility beyond the connected account’s access.

tool_schemas.name: slack_find_channel
tool_schemas.description: Finds and returns a Slack channel whose name matches the provided name (without the leading #). It refuses requests that omit name or provide an empty name. It also refuses when Slack is not connected, when the channel is not visible to the connected account, or when no channel with that name exists.

tool_schemas.name: slack_get_channel_messages
tool_schemas.description: Returns recent messages posted in the specified Slack channel and includes message content and metadata available to the connected account. It refuses requests missing channel_id, with an empty/unknown channel_id, or when the channel is not accessible to the connected account. It also refuses when Slack is not connected or the token lacks permission to read channel history.

tool_schemas.name: slack_send_channel_message
tool_schemas.description: Posts a new message to the specified Slack channel and returns the created message record. Refuses requests with a missing or blank channel_id or text, or where the channel_id does not correspond to a channel the service can access. Refuses requests when the target channel is not available for posting (for example, it is archived or otherwise disallows new messages).

metadata.name: HelioOps Marketing Automations
metadata.description: A lightweight marketing-ops automation service that connects Slack, email campaigns, and spreadsheets to list audiences and campaigns, fetch reports, create new campaigns, and read/write sheet data while messaging teams in channels.
